scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city square with a large white building in the background and a smaller brown building to its left. The white building has many windows and a tower on top. There are people walking around the square and cars parked along the street. A woman is taking a picture of the white building with her phone. The ground is made of gray stone tiles. There are two black trash cans in the middle of the square. There are also some trees and other buildings in the distance.
